title: Hightouch Sync Sync Duration p95
app: Hightouch sync run events via the Hightouch API/webhooks to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=hightouch:sync status="success"
| eval dur_min=round(duration_ms/60000,2)
| stats avg(dur_min) as avg_min, p95(dur_min) as p95_min, count as runs by sync_name
| where p95_min>30
| sort - p95_min
description: Computes the 95th-percentile sync duration for each sync in Hightouch and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Hightouch syncs by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Hightouch timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest syncs with their owners.
visualization: Table of sync by p95 sync duration, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Hightouch so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
